name: AnimeClick Metadata
description: Provider metadati anime in italiano basato su AnimeClick.it con scraping etico e cache locale.
overview: Fornisce titoli, trame, generi, valutazioni e cover art in italiano per anime, utilizzando AnimeClick.it come fonte.

versions.changelog: Initial Public Release. Metadati testo in italiano, Provider Cast/Staff integrato, Gestione Sigle e Rate-Limiting protetto con SemaphoreSlim.

description:
Enhanced plugin for Jellyfin that fetches anime themes (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe.
Supports multiple ID providers (AniDB, MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu, AniSearch) with configurable priority, title-based fallback, and persistent caching.
name: KometaThemes
overview: Plugin for Jellyfin that fetches anime themes (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe with multi-provider support

versions.changelog: 0.9 release: provider priority is now configurable from the UI, cache stats are live with a clear action, FetchType parsing is tolerant, and AniSearch priority is normalized correctly.
